name: DataLabel
description: Represents the data label on a chart point or trendline.
remarks: On a series, the DataLabel object is a member of the DataLabels collection. The DataLabels collection contains a DataLabel object for each point. For a series without definable points (such as an area series), the DataLabels collection contains a single DataLabel object.
example:
With ActiveDocument.InlineShapes(1)

    If .HasChart Then

        .Chart.SeriesCollection(1).DataLabels(5).NumberFormat = "0.000"

    End If

End With

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent for the specified object. Read-only Object.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns the name of the object. Read-only String.

properties.name: Caption
properties.description: Returns or sets the data label text. Read/write String.

properties.name: Characters
properties.description: Returns a ChartCharacters object that represents a range of characters within the object text. Use the ChartCharacters object to format characters within a text string.

properties.name: HorizontalAlignment
properties.description: Returns or sets the horizontal alignment for the specified object. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance, in points, from the left edge of the object to the left edge of the chart area. Read/write Double.

properties.name: Orientation
properties.description: Returns or sets the text orientation. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Shadow
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates whether the object has a shadow. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Text
properties.description: Returns or sets the text for the specified object. Read/write String.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance, in points, from the top edge of the object to the top of the first row (on a worksheet) or the top of the chart area (on a chart). Read/write Double.

properties.name: VerticalAlignment
properties.description: Returns or sets the vertical alignment of the specified object. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: ReadingOrder
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlReadingOrder constant that represents the reading order for the specified object. Read/write Long.

properties.name: AutoText
properties.description: True if the object automatically generates appropriate text based on context. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: NumberFormat
properties.description: Returns or sets the format code for the object. Read/write String.

properties.name: NumberFormatLinked
properties.description: True if the number format is linked to the cells (so that the number format changes in the labels when it changes in the cells). Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: NumberFormatLocal
properties.description: Returns or sets the format code for the object as a string in the language of the user. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: ShowLegendKey
properties.description: True if the data label legend key is visible. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Position
properties.description: Returns or sets the position of the data label. Read/write XlDataLabelPosition.

properties.name: ShowSeriesName
properties.description: True to show the series name for the data labels on a chart. False to hide the series name. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowCategoryName
properties.description: True to display the category name for the data labels on a chart. False to hide the category name. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowValue
properties.description: True to display a specified chart's data label values. False to hide the values. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowPercentage
properties.description: True to display the percentage value for the data labels on a chart. False to hide the value. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowBubbleSize
properties.description: True to show the bubble size for the data labels on a chart. False to hide the bubble size. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Separator
properties.description: Returns or sets the separator used for the data labels on a chart. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Format
properties.description: Returns the line, fill, and effect formatting for the object. Read-only ChartFormat.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft PowerPoint application. When used with an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return the application of that object). Read-only.

properties.name: Formula
properties.description: Returns or sets the object's formula in A1-style notation. Read/write.

properties.name: FormulaR1C1
properties.description: Returns or sets the formula for the object, using R1C1-style notation in the language of the macro. Read/write String.

properties.name: FormulaLocal
properties.description: Returns or sets the formula for the object, using A1-style references in the language of the user. Read/write String.

properties.name: FormulaR1C1Local
properties.description: Returns or sets the formula for the object, using R1C1-style notation in the language of the user. Read/write String.

properties.name: ShowRange
properties.description: Set to True to display the Value From Cells range field for the specified chart data label. Set to False to hide that field. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns the height, in points, of the object. Read-only.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns the width, in points, of the object. Read-only.
